title: A micro-nano formulation of multi-micronutrient- and carbon nanofiber-modified biochar for enhanced plant growth
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2076-2090
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00802B, Paper
Abhishek Gupta, Rahul Gupta, Nishith Verma
Modification of biochar with B, Mo, and Cu augmented not only the water holding capacity of soil but also plant growth, attributed to the efficient translocation of the micronutrients by carbon nanofibers.
